technical_requirements: Primary performance target: 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for chat and recommendation logits at 128-token window
Min sustained throughput requested: 12,000 tokens/sec (across model endpoints, aggregated)
Peak throughput estimate: 45,000 tokens/sec (burst windows during promotion events)
Concurrency cap preference: hard cap of 400 concurrent requests per tenant route; want per-route caps
Burst policy: allow 3x sustained for up to 5 minutes, then enforced rate-limit; prefer automatic burst to shared capacity first
KV/prefix cache requirement: cache hot prefixes for 20% of workload to reduce token compute cost
Model preference: LLaMA-variant quantized to int8 for embeddings and reranking; newer decoder for chat (16k context)
sla_terms: Measurement window: 30-day rolling for throughput SLO; monthly report with token/sec percentiles
Credits: 5% monthly credit if min_tokens/sec missed more than 2 non-overlapping 10-minute windows per month; escalation path to account exec
SLO definitions: min_tokens/sec guaranteed at region level (NA), with documented fallbacks to compatible model variants
Exclusions: planned maintenance windows (48h notice) and force majeure events excluded
Termination clause: customer may reduce commitment if sustained miss >3 months (with pro-rated credits)
negotiation_position: Customer opening ask: firm 15k tokens/sec guaranteed + unlimited burst to shared infra
Redwood counter: 12k tokens/sec guaranteed on reserved pool + burst allowance up to 3x for short windows to shared capacity; propose explicit burst throttling rules
Concessions on table: extend reserved GPU count by 1 for first 3 months to ease cutover; provide enhanced telemetry at no charge for first 6 months
Deal-breaker for customer: SLA without explicit min_tokens/sec and per-route concurrency caps
Legal sticking point: definition and calculation of credits (how to compute short windows aggregations).
contract_sizing_proposal: Baseline reserved: 8xA100-equivalent GPUs (reserved), expected to sustain ~12k tokens/sec with batching & cache
Optional scale: +4 GPUs as burst buffer behind autoscaler for predictable promotions
Billing model: monthly reserved fee + overage for burst beyond agreed monthly token allowance
Suggested quant: agree on a token accounting model (token weight by model type) in appendix
risk_assessment: High: CFO cost pushback if reserved pool much larger than average usage
Medium: legal delays around SLA credit calc
Low: technical fit - SE already validated model performance with sample traffic
